withheld.title: What you don't take with you
withheld.intro: This list is computed from what the export can actually produce, so it can't fall behind the product.
withheld.sharedMarket: The shared reference data — the company directory, public registries, territory snapshots. It is funded collectively and serves every workspace: nobody takes it away, nobody loses it.
withheld.sharedOperator: The models, scoring rules and internal components of the product. That is what we build, not what you entrust to us.
withheld.workspaceOwned: What belongs to the workspace rather than to you alone — projects, missions, invoicing. A personal copy carrying them would hand you your colleagues' work.
withheld.unclassified: Data whose ownership we haven't settled yet. While the question is open it doesn't leave: we'd rather write that down than guess.

sensitive.title: Delete my {{brand}} account
sensitive.lead: A one-way action. Take the time to read what it does before starting it.
sensitive.erased: Erased: your identity, contacts, consultants and uploaded documents are anonymised; your sessions are revoked and your subscription is cancelled.
sensitive.when: When: immediately, on confirmation. There is no cooling-off period.
sensitive.kept_one: Kept, without your name: the billing line, the credit ledger, the action log and company data — accounting obligations. They are purged after {{count}} day.
sensitive.kept_other: Kept, without your name: the billing line, the credit ledger, the action log and company data — accounting obligations. They are purged after {{count}} days.
sensitive.members: Your colleagues: anything owned by the workspace stays there. It is your account that leaves, not your team’s work.
sensitive.irreversible: Irreversible: nothing that is anonymised can be restored, by you or by us.
sensitive.exportFirst: Export first. Afterwards, there is nothing left to export.
